description_en: The ModifyACLRule operation modifies an access control rule
description_zh: 调用ModifyACLRule接口修改访问控制规则
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-acl-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-xhwhyuo43l0n0000000 --acr-id acr-u98qztgtgvhb00000000 --description test --direction in --source-cidr 0.0.0.0/0 --dest-cidr 0.0.0.0/0 --ip-protocol tcp --source-port-range 80/80 --dest-port-range 80/80 --policy accept --priority 2 --type LAN --name doctest --dpi-signature-ids 1 --dpi-group-ids 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyACLRule

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the access control list (ACL) instance
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ACL instance
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access control rule.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114017.html operation to query the IDs of access control rules in an ACL instance
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则ID。

您可以通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114017.html查询访问控制实例下访问控制规则的ID
parameters.name: acr_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the access control rule.

The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则的描述信息。

描述长度为1~512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The direction in which the access control rule is applied. Valid values:

in: inbound. This is the direction of traffic from an external network to the on-premises network where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed.
out: outbound. This is the direction of traffic from the on-premises network where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed to an external network
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则应用方向。取值：

in：入方向，指从外部访问智能接入网关实例所在的本地网络的方向。
out：出方向，指从智能接入网关实例所在的本地网络访问外部的方向
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The source CIDR block.

The source CIDR block must be in CIDR format. For example: 192.168.1.0/24
parameters.help_zh:
源网段。

源网段格式为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.1.0/24
parameters.name: source_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The destination CIDR block.

The destination CIDR block must be in CIDR format. For example: 192.168.10.0/24
parameters.help_zh:
目的网段。

目的网段格式为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.10.0/24
parameters.name: dest_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The protocol used by the access control rule.

For the protocols supported by the access control feature, see the information in the console. The protocol is not case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则应用的协议。

访问控制功能支持的协议类型，请以控制台为准。协议格式不区分大小写
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The source port range. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Examples of the source port range format:

1/200: ports 1 to 200.
80/80: port 80.
-1/-1: all ports
parameters.help_zh:
源端口范围。取值范围：-1或1~65535。

目的端口范围格式示例：

1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
80/80，表示端口80。
-1/-1，表示不限制端口
parameters.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_en:
The destination port range. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Examples of the destination port range format:

1/200: ports 1 to 200.
80/80: port 80.
-1/-1: all ports
parameters.help_zh:
目的端口范围。取值范围：-1或1~65535。

目的端口范围格式示例：

1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
80/80，表示端口80。
-1/-1，表示不限制端口
parameters.name: dest_port_range

parameters.help_en:
The authorization policy of the access control rule. Valid values:

accept: allows access.
drop: denies access
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则授权策略。取值：

accept：允许。

drop：拒绝
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the access control rule.

A smaller value indicates a higher priority. If rules have the same priority, the one that is first delivered to the Smart Access Gateway device takes precedence.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则优先级。

数值越小，优先级越高。同优先级时，先下发到智能接入网关设备的规则优先生效。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：1
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access control rule. Valid values:

LAN: (Default) private network. This value indicates that the access control rule applies to traffic from private IP addresses.
WAN: public network. This value indicates that the access control rule applies to traffic from public IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则类型。取值：

LAN：（默认值）私网，表示针对私网地址的流量设置访问控制规则。

WAN：公网，表示针对公网地址的流量设置访问控制规则
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the access control rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: A list of application IDs that the access control rule matches
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制规则匹配的应用ID列表
parameters.name: dpi_signature_ids

parameters.help_en: A list of application group IDs that the access control rule matches
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制规则匹配的应用组ID列表
parameters.name: dpi_group_ids
